title: IMPORTANT NOTICE: TELEVISION/INTERNET SERVICE CHANGE
summary: The Board of Directors has approved the discontin…
public_detail: The Board of Directors has approved the discontinuation of the coaxial cable system, effective July 31, 2026 . What This Means for You After July 31, 2026, television and internet services will be available only through the fiber-optic cable system. The existing coaxial cable system will no longer be operational. Action Required If you currently use coaxial cable connections for your television or internet service, you must transition to the fiber optic system before July 31, 2026 , to avoid any interruption in service. Need Assistance? For questions or help with setting up fiber optic service, please contact: Spectrum Community Solutions 877-647-7732 For general questions, please contact: Palm Hill Business Office (727) 581-8729 Thank you for your prompt attention to this important service upgrade. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
